# Austic Scrap & E-Waste Recycling - Complete Knowledge Graph & Service Documentation

## Company Overview
Austic Scrap (Austic Scrap and Recycling) is a leading provider of end-to-end office asset liquidation, corporate scrap management, IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), certified data destruction, and government-compliant e-waste recycling in India. 

Headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal, Austic Scrap provides on-site scrap evaluation, certified dismantling, heavy equipment rigging, zero-landfill electronic recycling, and certified data sanitization across India’s major commercial hubs.

- **Primary URL**: https://www.austicscrap.com
- **Headquarters**: 40/c/1c/1/H Raja Santosh Roy Road, Kolkata - 700027, West Bengal, India
- **Phone**: +91 62055 18929
- **Email**: austicscrap@gmail.com
- **Business Hours**: Monday to Sunday: 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM IST
- **Service Mode**: On-site pickup, industrial logistics, free doorstep evaluation, digital weight verification, instant bank settlement.

---

## Complete Services Breakdown

### 1. E-Waste Recycling & Electronics Disposal
- **Accepted Items**: Desktops, laptops, monitors, motherboards, RAM, CPUs, graphics cards, enterprise servers, network switches, routers, telecom racks, UPS systems, power supplies, cables, transformers, circuit boards.
- **Eco-Friendly Process**: Segregation of hazardous materials (lead, mercury, cadmium, flame retardants), mechanical shredding, hydrometallurgical recovery of gold, silver, palladium, and copper.
- **Compliance**: Adherence to the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) E-Waste (Management) Rules, Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) and State Pollution Control Boards.

### 2. IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) & Secure Data Destruction
- **Services**: End-of-life IT lifecycle management, asset remarketing, certified data destruction, serialized chain of custody.
- **Data Security**: NIST 800-88 Rev 1 and DoD 5220.22-M compliant magnetic degaussing and mechanical high-torque shredding of HDDs, SSDs, magnetic tapes, and flash drives.
- **Documentation**: Tamper-proof Certificates of Data Destruction (COD) and Green Recycling Certificates provided for internal audits and ESG reporting.

### 3. Corporate Office Scrap & Decommissioning
- **Accepted Items**: Office workstations, modular desks, executive chairs, conference tables, glass partitions, aluminum frames, cubicles, false ceiling grids, flooring materials, steel cabinets.
- **Office Relocation & Demolition**: Safe dismantling of corporate office interiors with zero structural damage and rapid turnaround.

### 4. Heavy Commercial & Industrial Scrap Buying
- **DG Sets & Generators**: Obsolete industrial diesel generators, silent canopy generators, Kirloskar, Cummins, Caterpillar, Ashok Leyland DG sets of all KVA capacities.
- **HVAC & Cooling Systems**: Commercial chiller plants, VRV/VRF systems, ductable split ACs, window ACs, copper piping, compressors, cooling towers.
- **Battery Recycling**: Industrial inverter batteries, submarine batteries, UPS lead-acid batteries, telecom backup batteries, lithium-ion packs with authorized smelting and acid neutralization.
- **Metals**: Ferrous and non-ferrous scrap including high-grade copper wire, copper scrap, aluminum sections, brass valves, stainless steel 304/316, cast iron, mild steel structural beams.

## 4-Step Transparent Scrap Selling Process
1. **Inquiry & Request**: Contact via phone at +91 62055 18929 or submit the online form at https://www.austicscrap.com/contact.
2. **On-Site Inspection & Quote**: Our technical team conducts physical or virtual inspection to provide transparent, market-linked pricing.
3. **Professional Dismantling & Logistics**: Trained team handles de-installation, safe packaging, and heavy transport without disrupting client operations.
4. **Certified Disposal & Immediate Settlement**: Digital weighing scales, instant bank payment (NEFT/RTGS/UPI), followed by Certificate of Recycling and Destruction.
